```typescript
/**
 * ZENTRALE EVENT-VERTEILUNG
 * Typsichere Event-Kommunikation zwischen Komponenten
 */

export type EventType =
  | 'WEBSOCKET_STATUS' | 'WEBSOCKET_MESSAGE'
  | 'SYMBOLS_UPDATE' | 'TICKER_UPDATE'
  | 'TRADE_UPDATE' | 'ORDERBOOK_UPDATE' | 'KLINE_UPDATE';

type CB<T = any> = (payload: T) => void;

export class EventBus {
  private listeners = new Map<EventType, Set<CB>>();

  /**
   * Event-Subscription mit automatischem Cleanup
   * @param type Event-Typ
   * @param callback Handler-Funktion
   * @returns Unsubscribe-Funktion
   */
  subscribe<T>(type: EventType, callback: CB<T>): () => void {
    if (!this.listeners.has(type)) {
      this.listeners.set(type, new Set());
    }
    this.listeners.get(type)!.add(callback as CB);
    
    // Unsubscribe-Funktion zurückgeben
    return () => this.listeners.get(type)?.delete(callback as CB);
  }

  /**
   * Event emittieren
   * @param type Event-Typ  
   * @param payload Event-Daten
   */
  emit<T>(type: EventType, payload: T): void {
    const set = this.listeners.get(type);
    if (!set) return;
    
    set.forEach(fn => {
      try {
        (fn as CB<T>)(payload);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('[EventBus] Handler error:', type, error);
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Debug-Info für Entwicklung
   */
  getStats(): { totalTypes: number; totalListeners: number } {
    let totalListeners = 0;
    this.listeners.forEach(set => totalListeners += set.size);
    
    return {
      totalTypes: this.listeners.size,
      totalListeners
    };
  }
}

// Globale Event-Bus-Instanz
export const eventBus = new EventBus();
```

#### **DATEI: `src/core/events/EventRouter.ts`**

```typescript
/**
 * MESSAGE-PATTERN-ROUTING
 * Intelligente Weiterleitung von WebSocket-Messages zu Event-Types
 */

import { eventBus } from './EventBus';

// Pattern-Matching für Message-Types
const TYPE_PATTERNS = {
  symbols: /symbols_initial|symbols_update|coinlist|symbollist/i,
  ticker: /ticker_update|ticker|24hrticker/i,
  trade: /trade|aggtrade|trades/i,
  orderbook: /orderbook|depth/i,
  kline: /kline|candle/i
};

/**
 * Eingehende WebSocket-Message zu Events routen
 * @param msg WebSocket-Message
 */
export function routeInbound(msg: any): void {
  if (!msg || typeof msg !== 'object') return;
  
  const msgType = String(msg.type || '').toLowerCase();
  const now = Date.now();

  // TICKER-UPDATES
  if (TYPE_PATTERNS.ticker.test(msgType)) {
    const symbol = msg.symbol || msg.data?.symbol || 'UNKNOWN';
    const data = msg.data ?? msg;
    
    eventBus.emit('TICKER_UPDATE', {
      exchange: msg.exchange || 'unknown',
      symbol,
      data,
      timestamp: now,
    });
    return;
  }

  // SYMBOL-UPDATES  
  if (TYPE_PATTERNS.symbols.test(msgType)) {
    eventBus.emit('SYMBOLS_UPDATE', {
      exchange: msg.exchange || msg.data?.exchange || 'unknown',
      symbols: msg.symbols || msg.data?.symbols || msg.data || [],
      raw: msg,
      timestamp: now,
    });
    return;
  }

  // TRADE-UPDATES
  if (TYPE_PATTERNS.trade.test(msgType)) {
    eventBus.emit('TRADE_UPDATE', {
      exchange: msg.exchange || 'unknown',
      symbol: msg.symbol || msg.data?.symbol || 'UNKNOWN',
      data: msg.data ?? msg,
      timestamp: now,
    });
    return;
  }

  // ORDERBOOK-UPDATES
  if (TYPE_PATTERNS.orderbook.test(msgType)) {
    eventBus.emit('ORDERBOOK_UPDATE', {
      exchange: msg.exchange || 'unknown',
      symbol: msg.symbol || msg.data?.symbol || 'UNKNOWN',
      bids: msg.data?.bids || msg.bids || [],
      asks: msg.data?.asks || msg.asks || [],
      timestamp: now,
    });
    return;
  }

  // KLINE/CANDLE-UPDATES
  if (TYPE_PATTERNS.kline.test(msgType)) {
    eventBus.emit('KLINE_UPDATE', {
      exchange: msg.exchange || 'unknown',
      symbol: msg.symbol || msg.data?.symbol || 'UNKNOWN',
      interval: msg.interval || msg.data?.interval,
      candle: msg.data ?? msg,
      timestamp: now,
    });
    return;
  }

  // FALLBACK: Alle anderen Messages als generisches Event
  eventBus.emit('WEBSOCKET_MESSAGE', {
    type: msgType,
    data: msg,
    timestamp: now,
  });
}

/**
 * WebSocket-Status-Events emittieren
 * @param payload Status-Information
 */
export function emitWsStatus(payload: any): void {
  eventBus.emit('WEBSOCKET_STATUS', {
    ...payload,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
  });
}
```

#### **DATEI: `src/core/events/bootstrap.ts`**

```typescript
/**
 * EVENT-SYSTEM INTEGRATION
 * Verbindet bestehendes WebSocketService mit neuem Event-System
 */

import { WebSocketService } from '../../services/api/websocket';
import { routeInbound, emitWsStatus } from './EventRouter';

let isWired = false;

/**
 * Event-System initialisieren und mit WebSocketService verbinden
 */
export function bootstrapEvents(): void {
  // Nur einmal initialisieren
  if (isWired) {
    console.warn('[EventBus] Already bootstrapped');
    return;
  }

  const wsService = WebSocketService.getInstance();

  // INTEGRATION: Alle WebSocket-Messages zu Event-Router weiterleiten
  wsService.subscribe('message', (msg: any) => {
    routeInbound(msg);
  });

  // INTEGRATION: WebSocket-Status-Events weiterleiten
  wsService.subscribe('connected', () => {
    emitWsStatus({ 
      status: 'connected',
      source: 'websocket'
    });
  });

  wsService.subscribe('disconnected', () => {
    emitWsStatus({ 
      status: 'disconnected',
      source: 'websocket'
    });
  });

  wsService.subscribe('error', (error: any) => {
    emitWsStatus({ 
      status: 'error', 
      error,
      source: 'websocket'
    });
  });

  isWired = true;
  console.log('[EventBus] System bootstrapped successfully');
}

/**
 * Event-System zurücksetzen (für Testing)
 */
export function resetEventSystem(): void {
  isWired = false;
  console.log('[EventBus] System reset');
}
```

#### **DATEI: `src/hooks/useEvent.ts`**

```typescript
/**
 * REACT HOOK FÜR EVENT-SYSTEM
 * Typsichere Event-Subscription mit automatischem Cleanup
 */

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { eventBus, EventType } from '../core/events/EventBus';

/**
 * Event-Hook für React-Komponenten
 * @param type Event-Typ
 * @param callback Handler-Funktion
 * @param deps Dependency-Array
 */
export function useEvent<T = any>(
  type: EventType,
  callback: (payload: T) => void,
  deps: any[] = []
): void {
  const callbackRef = useRef(callback);
  
  // Callback-Referenz aktuell halten
  useEffect(() => {
    callbackRef.current = callback;
  }, [callback]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Event-Subscription mit stabiler Callback-Referenz
    const unsubscribe = eventBus.subscribe<T>(type, (payload: T) => {
      callbackRef.current(payload);
    });

    // Cleanup bei Komponenten-Unmount
    return unsubscribe;
  }, [type, ...deps]);
}

/**
 * Event-Hook mit Conditional-Logic
 * @param type Event-Typ
 * @param condition Bedingung wann Event gehört werden soll
 * @param callback Handler-Funktion
 * @param deps Dependency-Array
 */
export function useConditionalEvent<T = any>(
  type: EventType,
  condition: boolean,
  callback: (payload: T) => void,
  deps: any[] = []
): void {
  useEvent<T>(
    type,
    condition ? callback : () => {},
    [condition, ...deps]
  );
}
```

```typescript
// In der WebSocketService-Klasse hinzufügen:
type Inbound = { type?: string; data?: any; [k: string]: any };

private dispatchInbound(message: Inbound): void {
  // Immer komplettes Rohobjekt broadcasten
  this.emit('message', message);

  // Bestehendes Verhalten beibehalten
  if (message && typeof message.type === 'string' && 'data' in message) {
    this.emit(message.type as string, message.data);
  } else {
    this.emit('raw_message', message);
  }
}
```

**🔧 SCHRITT A3: onmessage Handler umbauen**

```typescript
// Bestehenden onmessage Handler ERSETZEN mit:
this.ws.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent) => {
  try {
    const message: Inbound = JSON.parse(event.data);

    // Vorhandene Logs/Checks bleiben erlaubt
    if (!(message && 'data' in message && 'type' in message)) {
      console.warn('Invalid WebSocket message format:', message);
    }

    // 🆕 EINZIGE Quelle der Verteilung
    this.dispatchInbound(message);

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('WebSocket message parse error:', error);
    this.emit('error', error);
  }
};
```

// In der Klasse:
private dispatchInbound(message: Inbound): void {
  this.emit('message', message);            // neuer, vollständiger Stream
  if (message && typeof message.type === 'string' && 'data' in message) {
    this.emit(message.type, message.data);  // bestehendes Verhalten
  } else {
    this.emit('raw_message', message);
  }
}

// onmessage (einziger Codepfad)
this.ws.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent) => {
  try {
    const message: Inbound = JSON.parse(event.data);
    this.dispatchInbound(message);
  } catch (error) {
    this.emit('error', error);
  }
};
```

### **3) Bootstrap vor Render**

```typescript

// dann createRoot(...)
```

```

### **5) Typische Checks**

* `subscribe('message', fn)` existiert und ist mit `WSEvents` typisiert.
* WS-`type` Strings matchen die Regex im `EventRouter` (`ticker|trade|orderbook|kline|symbols`).

eventBus.subscribe('TICKER_UPDATE', t => console.log('TICK:', t.symbol));

# 🚀 LANE-SYSTEM für Events (Ersetzt alten Event-Handler)

**PROJEKT:** DarkMa Trading System - Hochperformante Event-Architecture  
**AUFWAND:** 2 Stunden (Lane-System + Component Migration)  
**STATUS:** ✅ Production-Ready - Ersetzt `readme/13_eventhandler.md`

---

## 🎯 **SYSTEM-ÜBERSICHT**

### **Problem des alten Event-Systems:**
❌ **Component-Listener-Chaos:** Jede Komponente braucht eigene `useEvent()` Listener  
❌ **Performance-Bottlenecks:** Keine Batching, alle Events sofort verarbeitet  
❌ **Memory-Leaks:** Event-Subscription-Management in jeder Komponente  
❌ **Synchronisations-Probleme:** L/H Button Click → Components bekommen Update nicht mit

### **Lösung: Lane-System Architecture**
✅ **Null Component-Listener:** Nur noch Selector-Hooks (`useFastSnapshot`, `useMiddleState`, `useSlow`)  
✅ **Performance-optimiert:** FAST (rAF+Ring), MIDDLE (Microtask), SLOW (Map)  
✅ **Zentrale Konfiguration:** Alle Event-zu-Lane-Zuweisungen in `DOMAIN_CONFIG`  
✅ **Automatische Synchronisation:** Ein Event → alle Components automatisch updated

---

## 🏗️ **ARCHITEKTUR**

```
┌─────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────┐
│   EventBus      │───▶│   LaneBridge    │───▶│   Lane Stores   │───▶│ Selector-Hooks  │
│                 │    │                 │    │                 │    │                 │
│ emit('EVENT')   │    │ DOMAIN_CONFIG   │    │ FAST: rAF+Ring  │    │ useFastSnapshot │
│                 │    │ Event→Lane      │    │ MIDDLE: μTask   │    │ useMiddleState  │
│                 │    │ Mapping         │    │ SLOW: Map       │    │ useSlow         │
└─────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘
```

### **Lane-Performance-Charakteristika:**

| Lane | Batch-Mechanismus | Use Cases | Performance |
|------|-------------------|-----------|-------------|
| **FAST** | requestAnimationFrame + RingBuffer | Charts, OrderBook, Trades | ~60 FPS, konstantes RAM |
| **MIDDLE** | Microtask Batching | Ticker, Symbols | ~1ms Latenz |
| **SLOW** | Map Replace/Merge | Settings, Config | Sofortige Persistierung |

---

## 📁 **DATEIEN**

### **Neu zu erstellen:**
1. `src/shared/config/domainLanes.ts` – Lane-Zuweisung pro EventType
2. `src/shared/state/laneStores.ts` – drei Stores + Selector-Hooks  
3. `src/shared/events/bridges/laneBridge.ts` – eine generische Bridge
4. `src/shared/state/SettingsProvider.tsx` – SLOW-Auto-Sync

### **Zu ändern:**
5. `src/shared/events/bootstrap.ts` – `initLaneBridge()` aufrufen (von core/events verschieben)
6. `src/main.tsx` – `<SettingsProvider>` um `<App/>` 
7. `src/shared/events/EventBus.ts` – EventType um `SETTINGS_UPDATE` erweitern (von core/events verschieben)
8. `src/services/api/trading.ts` – `getSettings()`/`saveSettings()` emittieren Events

### **Migration erforderlich:**
9. `src/core/events/` → `src/shared/events/` verschieben (EventBus.ts, EventRouter.ts, bootstrap.ts)

---

#### **`src/shared/config/domainLanes.ts`**

```typescript
export type Lane = 'FAST'|'MIDDLE'|'SLOW';

export type Domain =
  | 'KLINE_UPDATE'|'ORDERBOOK_UPDATE'|'TRADE_UPDATE'
  | 'TICKER_UPDATE'|'SYMBOLS_UPDATE'|'SETTINGS_UPDATE'
  | 'WEBSOCKET_STATUS'|'WEBSOCKET_MESSAGE';

export interface DomainConfig {
  lane: Lane;
  keyOf: (payload: any) => string;
  reducer?: (batch: any[], prev: any) => any;
}

export const DOMAIN_CONFIG: Record<Domain, DomainConfig> = {
  // FAST Lane: Charts, OrderBook, Trades (rAF-Batched)
  KLINE_UPDATE:    { 
    lane: 'FAST', 
    keyOf: p => `kline:${p.symbol}:${p.interval || '1m'}`,
    reducer: (batch) => batch[batch.length - 1] // Latest candle wins
  },
  ORDERBOOK_UPDATE: { 
    lane: 'FAST', 
    keyOf: p => `ob:${p.symbol}:${p.exchange}`,
    reducer: (batch) => batch[batch.length - 1] // Latest orderbook wins
  },
  TRADE_UPDATE: { 
    lane: 'FAST', 
    keyOf: p => `trades:${p.symbol}:${p.exchange}`,
    reducer: (batch) => batch // Keep all trades in batch
  },
  
  // MIDDLE Lane: Ticker, Symbols (Microtask-Batched)
  TICKER_UPDATE:   { 
    lane: 'MIDDLE', 
    keyOf: p => `ticker:${p.symbol}:${p.exchange}`
  },
  SYMBOLS_UPDATE:  { 
    lane: 'MIDDLE', 
    keyOf: p => `symbols:${p.exchange || 'all'}`
  },
  
  // SLOW Lane: Settings, Config (Immediate Persistence)
  SETTINGS_UPDATE: { 
    lane: 'SLOW', 
    keyOf: _ => 'settings' 
  },
  WEBSOCKET_STATUS: { 
    lane: 'SLOW', 
    keyOf: _ => 'ws_status' 
  },
  WEBSOCKET_MESSAGE: { 
    lane: 'MIDDLE', 
    keyOf: p => `ws_msg:${p.type || 'unknown'}`
  },
};
```

#### **`src/shared/state/laneStores.ts`**

```typescript
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

// ========== FAST LANE: rAF + RingBuffer ==========
type Listener = () => void;

class RingBuffer<T> {
  private array: T[];
  private index = 0;
  private filled = false;

  constructor(private capacity: number) {
    this.array = new Array<T>(capacity);
  }

  push(value: T) {
    this.array[this.index] = value;
    this.index = (this.index + 1) % this.capacity;
    if (this.index === 0) this.filled = true;
  }

  drain(): T[] {
    const output: T[] = [];
    if (!this.filled && this.index === 0) return output;
    
    if (!this.filled) {
      // Partially filled - return from start to index
      for (let k = 0; k < this.index; k++) {
        output.push(this.array[k]!);
      }
      this.index = 0;
      return output;
    }
    
    // Fully filled - return from index (oldest) to end, then start to index
    for (let k = 0; k < this.capacity; k++) {
      output.push(this.array[(this.index + k) % this.capacity]!);
    }
    this.index = 0;
    this.filled = false;
    return output;
  }
}

type FastState = {
  version: number;
  snapshot: any;
  buffer: RingBuffer<any>;
  rafId: number | null;
  listeners: Set<Listener>;
  reducer?: (batch: any[], prev: any) => any;
};

const fastMap = new Map<string, FastState>();

function getFastState(key: string, reducer?: FastState['reducer']): FastState {
  let state = fastMap.get(key);
  if (!state) {
    state = {
      version: 0,
      snapshot: null,
      buffer: new RingBuffer(2048), // 2048 events max per frame
      rafId: null,
      listeners: new Set(),
      reducer
    };
    fastMap.set(key, state);
  }
  if (reducer && !state.reducer) {
    state.reducer = reducer;
  }
  return state;
}

function scheduleFastFlush(state: FastState) {
  if (state.rafId !== null) return;
  
  state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    state.rafId = null;
    const batch = state.buffer.drain();
    if (batch.length) {
      state.snapshot = state.reducer 
        ? state.reducer(batch, state.snapshot)
        : batch[batch.length - 1];
      state.version++;
      state.listeners.forEach(listener => listener());
    }
  });
}

export function fastPush(key: string, payload: any, reducer?: FastState['reducer']) {
  const state = getFastState(key, reducer);
  state.buffer.push(payload);
  scheduleFastFlush(state);
}

export function useFastSnapshot<T = any>(key: string): T | null {
  const state = getFastState(key);
  
  const subscribe = (listener: Listener) => {
    state.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => state.listeners.delete(listener);
  };
  
  const getSnapshot = () => state.version;
  
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
  return state.snapshot as T | null;
}

// ========== MIDDLE LANE: Microtask Batch ==========
type MiddleState = {
  version: number;
  map: Map<string, any>;
  queue: Array<{ key: string; payload: any }>;
  isEnqueued: boolean;
  listeners: Set<Listener>;
};

const middleState: MiddleState = {
  version: 0,
  map: new Map(),
  queue: [],
  isEnqueued: false,
  listeners: new Set()
};

function flushMiddle() {
  if (!middleState.queue.length) return;
  
  for (const { key, payload } of middleState.queue) {
    middleState.map.set(key, payload);
  }
  middleState.queue.length = 0;
  middleState.version++;
  middleState.listeners.forEach(listener => listener());
}

export function middlePush(key: string, payload: any) {
  middleState.queue.push({ key, payload });
  
  if (!middleState.isEnqueued) {
    middleState.isEnqueued = true;
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      middleState.isEnqueued = false;
      flushMiddle();
    });
  }
}

export function useMiddleState<T = any>(key: string): T | undefined {
  const subscribe = (listener: Listener) => {
    middleState.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => middleState.listeners.delete(listener);
  };
  
  const getSnapshot = () => middleState.version;
  
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
  return middleState.map.get(key) as T | undefined;
}

// ========== SLOW LANE: Immediate Map Updates ==========
type SlowState = {
  version: number;
  map: Map<string, any>;
  listeners: Set<Listener>;
};

const slowState: SlowState = {
  version: 0,
  map: new Map(),
  listeners: new Set()
};

export function slowReplace(key: string, value: any) {
  slowState.map.set(key, value);
  slowState.version++;
  slowState.listeners.forEach(listener => listener());
}

export function slowUpsertMerge(key: string, partialValue: any) {
  const existing = slowState.map.get(key) || {};
  const merged = Array.isArray(existing) ? partialValue : { ...existing, ...partialValue };
  slowState.map.set(key, merged);
  slowState.version++;
  slowState.listeners.forEach(listener => listener());
}

export function useSlow<T = any>(key: string): T | undefined {
  const subscribe = (listener: Listener) => {
    slowState.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => slowState.listeners.delete(listener);
  };
  
  const getSnapshot = () => slowState.version;
  
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
  return slowState.map.get(key) as T | undefined;
}

// ========== DEBUG UTILITIES ==========
export function getLaneStats() {
  return {
    fast: {
      keys: fastMap.size,
      totalListeners: Array.from(fastMap.values()).reduce((sum, state) => sum + state.listeners.size, 0)
    },
    middle: {
      keys: middleState.map.size,
      listeners: middleState.listeners.size,
      queueSize: middleState.queue.length
    },
    slow: {
      keys: slowState.map.size,
      listeners: slowState.listeners.size
    }
  };
}
```

#### **`src/shared/events/bridges/laneBridge.ts`**

```typescript
import { DOMAIN_CONFIG, Domain } from '../../config/domainLanes';
import { eventBus } from '../EventBus';
import { fastPush, middlePush, slowReplace, slowUpsertMerge } from '../../state/laneStores';

// Duplicate event prevention
const seenEventIds = new Set<string>();

function isEventSeen(eventId?: string): boolean {
  return !!eventId && seenEventIds.has(eventId);
}

function markEventSeen(eventId?: string) {
  if (!eventId) return;
  seenEventIds.add(eventId);
  
  // Prevent memory leak: clear old IDs periodically
  if (seenEventIds.size > 10000) {
    seenEventIds.clear();
  }
}

export function initLaneBridge() {
  console.log('[LaneBridge] Initializing event routing...');
  
  // Subscribe to all configured domain events
  (Object.keys(DOMAIN_CONFIG) as Domain[]).forEach(domain => {
    eventBus.subscribe<any>(domain, (payload) => {
      // Skip duplicate events
      if (!payload || isEventSeen(payload.eventId)) {
        return;
      }
      
      const config = DOMAIN_CONFIG[domain];
      const key = config.keyOf(payload);
      
      // Route to appropriate lane
      switch (config.lane) {
        case 'FAST':
          fastPush(key, payload, config.reducer);
          break;
          
        case 'MIDDLE':
          middlePush(key, payload);
          break;
          
        case 'SLOW': {
          const action = payload.action as string | undefined;
          if (action === 'loaded' || action === 'sync') {
            slowReplace(key, payload.settings ?? payload);
          } else {
            slowUpsertMerge(key, payload.settings ?? payload);
          }
          break;
        }
        
        default:
          console.warn(`[LaneBridge] Unknown lane: ${config.lane} for domain: ${domain}`);
      }
      
      // Mark event as processed
      markEventSeen(payload.eventId);
    });
  });
  
  console.log(`[LaneBridge] Registered ${Object.keys(DOMAIN_CONFIG).length} domain routes`);
}

// Debug: Get bridge statistics
export function getLaneBridgeStats() {
  return {
    seenEventsCount: seenEventIds.size,
    registeredDomains: Object.keys(DOMAIN_CONFIG).length,
    domainConfig: DOMAIN_CONFIG
  };
}
```

#### **`src/shared/state/SettingsProvider.tsx`**

```typescript
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSlow } from './laneStores';
import { getSettings } from '../../services/api/trading';

export interface SettingsProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function SettingsProvider({ children }: SettingsProviderProps) {
  const settings = useSlow<any[]>('settings');
  
  useEffect(() => {
    // Initial load if no settings
    if (!settings || !settings.length) {
      console.log('[SettingsProvider] Loading initial settings...');
      getSettings();
    }
    
    // Auto-refresh on window focus
    const handleFocus = () => {
      console.log('[SettingsProvider] Window focus - refreshing settings');
      getSettings();
    };
    
    // Periodic refresh every minute
    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      console.log('[SettingsProvider] Periodic refresh - reloading settings');
      getSettings();
    }, 60_000);
    
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    
    return () => {
      clearInterval(intervalId);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    };
  }, [settings?.length]);
  
  return <>{children}</>;
}
```

```typescript
import { WebSocketService } from '../../services/api/websocket';
import { routeInbound, emitWsStatus } from './EventRouter';
import { initLaneBridge } from './bridges/laneBridge';

let isBootstrapped = false;

export function bootstrapEvents(): void {
  if (isBootstrapped) {
    console.warn('[EventBus] Already bootstrapped');
    return;
  }

  // Initialize Lane Bridge first
  initLaneBridge();

  // Existing WebSocket integration
  const wsService = WebSocketService.getInstance();

  wsService.subscribe('message', (msg: any) => {
    routeInbound(msg);
  });

  wsService.subscribe('connected', () => {
    emitWsStatus({ 
      status: 'connected',
      source: 'websocket'
    });
  });

  wsService.subscribe('disconnected', () => {
    emitWsStatus({ 
      status: 'disconnected',
      source: 'websocket'
    });
  });

  wsService.subscribe('error', (error: any) => {
    emitWsStatus({ 
      status: 'error', 
      error,
      source: 'websocket'
    });
  });

  isBootstrapped = true;
  console.log('[EventBus] System bootstrapped with Lane Bridge');
}

export function resetEventSystem(): void {
  isBootstrapped = false;
  console.log('[EventBus] System reset');
}
```

### **P4 – Settings API Events**

#### **Patch: `src/services/api/trading.ts`**

```typescript
import { eventBus } from '../../core/events/EventBus';

// Generate unique event IDs
function generateEventId(): string {
  return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
}

export class TradingAPI extends BaseAPI {
  static async getSettings(exchange?: Exchange): Promise<CoinSetting[]> {
    const url = exchange ? `/api/settings/settings?exchange=${exchange}` : '/api/settings/settings';
    
    try {
      const settings = await this.get<CoinSetting[]>(url);
      
      // Emit event for Lane Bridge
      eventBus.emit('SETTINGS_UPDATE', {
        eventId: generateEventId(),
        action: 'loaded',
        settings: settings,
        exchange: exchange,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      });
      
      return settings;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[TradingAPI] Settings load failed:', error);
      return [];
    }
  }

  static async saveSettings(settings: CoinSetting[]): Promise<boolean> {
    const eventId = generateEventId();
    
    try {
      // Optimistic update
      eventBus.emit('SETTINGS_UPDATE', {
        eventId: eventId,
        action: 'patched',
        settings: settings,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      });
      
      await this.post('/api/settings/settings', settings);
      
      // Confirm successful save
      eventBus.emit('SETTINGS_UPDATE', {
        eventId: generateEventId(),
        action: 'saved',
        settings: settings,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      });
      
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[TradingAPI] Settings save failed:', error);
      
      // Rollback: reload fresh settings
      try {
        const freshSettings = await this.get<CoinSetting[]>('/api/settings/settings');
        eventBus.emit('SETTINGS_UPDATE', {
          eventId: generateEventId(),
          action: 'loaded',
          settings: freshSettings,
          timestamp: Date.now()
        });
      } catch (rollbackError) {
        console.error('[TradingAPI] Settings rollback failed:', rollbackError);
      }
      
      return false;
    }
  }
}
```

export const useHybridData = (symbol: string, eventType: string) => {
  // Dynamic lane selection based on event type
  const fastData = useFastSnapshot<any>(`${eventType}:${symbol}`);
  const middleData = useMiddleState<any>(`${eventType}:${symbol}`);
  const wsStatus = useSlow<any>('ws_status');
  
  // Return appropriate data based on event type
  const data = ['KLINE_UPDATE', 'ORDERBOOK_UPDATE', 'TRADE_UPDATE'].includes(eventType) 
    ? fastData 
    : middleData;
  
  return { data, wsStatus };
};
```

#### **5. MarketTrades.tsx Component Migration**

**VORHER:**
```typescript
// features/trading/components/MarketTrades.tsx
import { useEvent } from '../../../hooks/useEvent';

const MarketTrades = ({ symbol, exchange }) => {
  const [trades, setTrades] = useState([]);
  
  useEvent('TRADE_UPDATE', (payload: any) => {
    if (payload.symbol === symbol && payload.exchange === exchange) {
      setTrades(prev => [...prev.slice(-19), payload]); // Keep last 20
    }
  });
  
  return (
    <div>{/* trades rendering */}</div>
  );
};
```

**NACHHER:**
```typescript
// features/trading/components/MarketTrades.tsx
import { useFastSnapshot } from '../../../core/state/laneStores';

const MarketTrades = ({ symbol, exchange }) => {
  // No manual state - direct from lane store
  const tradesBatch = useFastSnapshot<any[]>(`trades:${symbol}:${exchange}`) || [];
  const trades = tradesBatch.flat().slice(-20); // Keep last 20
  
  return (
    <div>{/* trades rendering */}</div>
  );
};

## ✅ **L/H BUTTON FIX (Kernproblem)**

### **Problem:** 
L/H Button Click → API Call ✅ → Settings gespeichert ✅ → **Components Update ❌**

### **Lösung mit Lane System:**

#### **1. L/H Button Handler (bleibt unverändert)**
```typescript
// features/trading/components/CoinSelector.tsx
const handleLiveToggle = async (symbol: string) => {
  const updated = settings.map(s => 
    s.symbol === symbol ? { ...s, live: !s.live } : s
  );
  
  // API Call triggers SETTINGS_UPDATE event automatically
  await saveSettings(updated);
};
```

#### **2. CoinSelector nutzt Lane Store**
```typescript
// features/trading/components/CoinSelector.tsx  
import { useSlow } from '../../../core/state/laneStores';

export const CoinSelector = ({ exchange }) => {
  // No useEvent needed - direct from SLOW lane
  const settings = useSlow<CoinSetting[]>('settings') || [];
  const filteredSettings = settings.filter(s => s.exchange === exchange);
  
  return (
    <div>
      {filteredSettings.map(setting => (
        <button
          key={`${setting.exchange}:${setting.symbol}`}
          className={setting.live ? 'bg-green-600' : 'bg-gray-700'}
          onClick={() => handleLiveToggle(setting.symbol)}
        >
          L: {setting.symbol}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### **3. DatabasePage nutzt Lane Store**
```typescript
// features/database/components/DatabasePage.tsx
import { useSlow } from '../../../core/state/laneStores';

export const DatabasePage = () => {
  // Automatically updates when settings change
  const settings = useSlow<CoinSetting[]>('settings') || [];
  
  return (
    <div>
      <h2>Database Overview</h2>
      <table>
        {settings.map(setting => (
          <tr key={`${setting.exchange}:${setting.symbol}`}>
            <td>{setting.symbol}</td>
            <td>{setting.live ? '✅' : '❌'}</td>
            <td>{setting.historical ? '✅' : '❌'}</td>
          </tr>
        ))}
      </table>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### **Ergebnis: Ein Event → alle Components automatisch updated! 🎯**

1. **L/H Button Click** → `saveSettings()` → `eventBus.emit('SETTINGS_UPDATE')`
2. **LaneBridge** → `slowReplace('settings', newSettings)`
3. **Alle Components** → `useSlow('settings')` → **automatisches Re-render**

## 🔄 **WEBSOCKET-RECONNECT IMPLEMENTATION - PRODUCTION-READY**

### **✅ WS-SPEZIFISCHE BACKOFF-LOGIK:**

**Alle 8 Exchange Configs haben bereits WebSocket-spezifische Retry-Methoden:**

```python
def next_ws_retry_delay(self, retry_count: int) -> float:
    """WebSocket-spezifische Retry Delay mit ws_retry_backoff_base"""
    delay = self.ws_retry_backoff_base ** max(1, retry_count)
    return min(delay, 60.0)
```

**WebSocket Environment Variables (alle Exchanges):**
- `{EXCHANGE}_WS_CONNECT_LIMIT` - Connect-Limit pro 5 Minuten (default: 300)
- `{EXCHANGE}_WS_MAX_CONN` - Max parallele Verbindungen (default: 10)
- `{EXCHANGE}_WS_BACKOFF` - Retry-Backoff Base (default: 1.5)
- `{EXCHANGE}_WS_RATE_LIMIT_METHOD` - deque|token_bucket (default: token_bucket)
- `{EXCHANGE}_WS_BURST_CAPACITY` - Token-Bucket Burst (default: 10)
- `{EXCHANGE}_WS_MONITORING` - Monitoring aktivieren (default: true)

### **✅ RATE-LIMITED RECONNECT-LOOP:**

**Production-Ready Implementation mit zwei Rate-Limiting-Strategien:**

#### **1) Deque-basiertes Zeitfenster (Binance 300/5min Enforcement)**
```python
from backend.core.websocket import WebSocketReconnectManager, RateLimitMethod

# Deque-Strategie für harte Limits
rate_config = RateLimitConfig(
    method=RateLimitMethod.DEQUE,
    connect_limit_per_5min=300,  # Binance Standard
    monitoring_enabled=True
)

# Zeitstempel-Fenster: O(1) Performance, ~wenige KB Speicher
# Verhindert Exchange-Bans durch Connect-Limit Enforcement
```

#### **2) Token-Bucket (Elegante Echtzeit-Drosselung)**
```python
# Token-Bucket für sanfte Rate-Kontrolle
rate_config = RateLimitConfig(
    method=RateLimitMethod.TOKEN_BUCKET,
    connect_limit_per_5min=300,
    burst_capacity=10,  # Erlaube 10 schnelle Connects
    monitoring_enabled=True
)

# Sanfte Drosselung ohne harte Wartezeiten
# Burst-Handling für kurze Connect-Spitzen
```

### **✅ PRODUCTION-READY RECONNECT-LOOP:**

**1:1 nutzbarer Async-Code mit Rate-Limiting und Jitter:**

```python
import asyncio, random, time
from backend.core.websocket import (
    WebSocketReconnectManager, WebSocketConfig, 
    ConnectionState, create_exchange_rate_limiter
)

async def create_exchange_websocket(exchange: str, url: str, exchange_config):
    """Erstellt production-ready WebSocket für Exchange"""
    
    # Config aus Exchange-Settings erstellen
    ws_config = WebSocketConfig.from_exchange_config(url, exchange, exchange_config)
    
    # Rate-Limiter mit Exchange-spezifischen Settings
    rate_limiter = create_exchange_rate_limiter(exchange)
    
    # Message Handler
    async def handle_message(message: str):
        try:
            # Hier WebSocket-Nachrichten verarbeiten
            data = json.loads(message)
            print(f"[{exchange}] Received: {data}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[{exchange}] Message error: {e}")
    
    # Connection State Handler
    async def handle_connection_state(state: ConnectionState):
        print(f"[{exchange}] Connection state: {state.value}")
        
        if state == ConnectionState.CONNECTED:
            # Subscribe to streams after successful connect
            await manager.send_message('{"method":"SUBSCRIBE","params":["btcusdt@trade"]}')
    
    # WebSocket Manager erstellen
    manager = WebSocketReconnectManager(
        config=ws_config,
        rate_limiter=rate_limiter,
        message_handler=handle_message,
        connection_handler=handle_connection_state
    )
    
    return manager

# Usage für alle 8 Exchanges
async def setup_multi_exchange_websockets():
    from backend.market.binance.config import binance_config
    from backend.market.bitget.config import bitget_config
    # ... weitere Exchange Configs
    
    managers = {}
    
    # Binance WebSocket
    managers['binance'] = await create_exchange_websocket(
        'binance', 
        'wss://stream.binance.com:9443/ws', 
        binance_config
    )
    
    # Bitget WebSocket  
    managers['bitget'] = await create_exchange_websocket(
        'bitget',
        'wss://ws.bitget.com/spot/v1/stream',
        bitget_config
    )
    
    # ... weitere Exchanges
    
    # Alle WebSockets starten
    for exchange, manager in managers.items():
        success = await manager.connect()
        print(f"{exchange} WebSocket started: {success}")
    
    return managers
```

### **✅ ADVANCED FEATURES:**

#### **Jitter und Exception-Handling:**
```python
# Automatisches Jitter (0.9-1.1x) in WebSocketReconnectManager
# Exponential Backoff: base^attempt mit Max-Cap
delay = base_delay * (2 ** min(attempt - 1, 10))
delay = min(delay, max_delay) * random.uniform(0.9, 1.1)

# Robustes Exception-Handling
try:
    async with websockets.connect(url) as ws:
        attempt = 0  # Reset nach erfolgreichem Connect
        async for message in ws:
            await handle_message(message)
except websockets.exceptions.ConnectionClosed:
    # Normal disconnect - reconnect
except Exception as e:
    # Unexpected error - log and reconnect with backoff
    logger.error(f"WebSocket error: {e}")
```

#### **Parallel-Verbindungs-Management:**

```python
# NEU ERSTELLT: backend/market/bitget/services/bitget_rest.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Bitget REST API Core Client
Core Bitget REST API Client für interne Verwendung.
"""

import logging
import aiohttp
import asyncio
import os
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger("bitget-rest-core")

class BitgetRestAPI:
    """Core Bitget REST API Client"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.base_url = os.getenv('BITGET_REST_URL', 'https://api.bitget.com')
        self._session = None
        
    async def fetch_spot_symbols(self) -> dict:
        return await self._request("/api/spot/v1/public/products")

    async def fetch_futures_symbols(self, product_type: str) -> dict:
        return await self._request(f"/api/mix/v1/market/contracts", {"productType": product_type})

    async def fetch_spot_tickers(self) -> List[dict]:
        data = await self._request("/api/spot/v1/market/tickers")
        return data.get("data", []) if data else []

    async def fetch_futures_tickers(self, product_type: str) -> dict:
        return await self._request(f"/api/mix/v1/market/tickers", {"productType": product_type})
```

### **1.1) ADAPTIVE RPS LOGIC INTEGRATION**

**Migration von `adaptive_rate_limiter.py` → `rate_limiters.py`:**

```python
# ERWEITERTE TokenBucketRateLimiter mit Adaptive Logic
class AdaptiveTokenBucketRateLimiter(TokenBucketRateLimiter):
    """Token Bucket mit adaptiver RPS-Anpassung"""
    
    def __init__(self, rate_per_second: float, burst_capacity: int = 10, monitoring: bool = True):
        super().__init__(rate_per_second, burst_capacity, monitoring)
        
        # Adaptive Logic aus alter Implementation
        self.base_rps = rate_per_second
        self.consecutive_successes = 0
        self.consecutive_failures = 0
        self.backoff_multiplier = 1.0
        self.recent_errors = deque(maxlen=10)
        
    def report_success(self):
        """Meldet erfolgreichen Request und passt RPS an"""
        super().record_connect()  # Normale Token-Behandlung
        
        self.consecutive_successes += 1
        self.consecutive_failures = 0
        
        # Rate vorsichtig erhöhen nach vielen Erfolgen
        if self.consecutive_successes > 20 and self.backoff_multiplier > 1.0:
            self.backoff_multiplier = max(1.0, self.backoff_multiplier * 0.9)
            
        if self.consecutive_successes > 50 and self.rate < self.base_rps * 1.2:
            self.rate = min(self.base_rps * 1.2, self.rate * 1.05)
    
    def report_error(self, error: Exception):
        """Meldet Fehler und reduziert RPS adaptiv"""
        self.consecutive_failures += 1
        self.consecutive_successes = 0
        
        error_type = type(error).__name__
        self.recent_errors.append((time.time(), error_type, str(error)[:100]))
        
        # Rate-Limiting-spezifische Fehler
        if any(keyword in str(error).lower() for keyword in 
               ['rate limit', 'too many requests', '429', '-1003', 'throttle']):
            self.backoff_multiplier = min(4.0, self.backoff_multiplier * 2.0)
            self.rate = max(0.1, self.rate * 0.5)  # Drastische Reduzierung
```

### **1.2) CIRCUIT BREAKER PATTERN INTEGRATION**

**Migration von `circuit_breaker.py` → `reconnect_manager.py`:**

```python
# ERWEITERTE WebSocketReconnectManager mit Circuit Breaker
class CircuitBreakerState(Enum):
    CLOSED = "closed"      # Normal operation
    OPEN = "open"          # Circuit open - fail fast
    HALF_OPEN = "half_open" # Testing recovery

class WebSocketReconnectManagerWithCircuitBreaker(WebSocketReconnectManager):
    """WebSocket Manager mit integriertem Circuit Breaker"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: WebSocketConfig, rate_limiter=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(config, rate_limiter, **kwargs)
        
        # Circuit Breaker State
        self.circuit_state = CircuitBreakerState.CLOSED
        self.circuit_failure_count = 0
        self.circuit_success_count = 0
        self.circuit_last_failure_time: Optional[float] = None
        
        # Circuit Breaker Config (aus alter Implementation)
        self.failure_threshold = 5
        self.recovery_timeout = 60.0
        self.success_threshold = 3
    
    async def _attempt_connection(self) -> bool:
        """Verbindungsversuch durch Circuit Breaker"""
        
        # Circuit Breaker Check
        if self.circuit_state == CircuitBreakerState.OPEN:
            if not self._should_attempt_circuit_reset():
                raise ConnectionError(f"Circuit breaker OPEN for {self.config.exchange}")
            else:
                self.circuit_state = CircuitBreakerState.HALF_OPEN
        
        try:
            # Original Connection Logic
            success = await super()._attempt_connection()
            
            if success:
                self._on_circuit_success()
            else:
                self._on_circuit_failure()
            
            return success
            
        except Exception as e:
            self._on_circuit_failure()
            raise
    
    def _should_attempt_circuit_reset(self) -> bool:
        """Prüft ob Circuit Reset versucht werden soll"""
        if not self.circuit_last_failure_time:
            return True
        return time.time() - self.circuit_last_failure_time >= self.recovery_timeout
    
    def _on_circuit_success(self):
        """Circuit Breaker Success Handler"""
        if self.circuit_state == CircuitBreakerState.HALF_OPEN:
            self.circuit_success_count += 1
            if self.circuit_success_count >= self.success_threshold:
                self.circuit_state = CircuitBreakerState.CLOSED
                self.circuit_failure_count = 0
                self.circuit_success_count = 0
                self.logger.info(f"🟢 Circuit breaker CLOSED for {self.config.exchange}")
        
        elif self.circuit_state == CircuitBreakerState.CLOSED:
            self.circuit_failure_count = 0
    
    def _on_circuit_failure(self):
        """Circuit Breaker Failure Handler"""
        self.circuit_failure_count += 1
        self.circuit_last_failure_time = time.time()
        
        if self.circuit_failure_count >= self.failure_threshold:
            self.circuit_state = CircuitBreakerState.OPEN
            self.logger.error(f"🔴 Circuit breaker OPENED for {self.config.exchange}")
        
        elif self.circuit_state == CircuitBreakerState.HALF_OPEN:
            self.circuit_state = CircuitBreakerState.OPEN
```

```python
# ERWEITERTE MultiExchangeWebSocketManager mit Health Monitoring
class MultiExchangeHealthMonitor(MultiExchangeWebSocketManager):
    """Multi-Exchange Manager mit Advanced Health Monitoring"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.health_check_interval = 30.0
        self.health_monitoring_active = False
        self.health_task: Optional[asyncio.Task] = None
        
        # Health Metrics
        self.system_health = {
            "redis": True,
            "clickhouse": True,
            "overall_throughput": 100.0,
            "overall_error_rate": 0.0,
            "total_active_connections": 0,
            "last_health_check": time.time()
        }
    
    async def start_health_monitoring(self):
        """Startet kontinuierliche Gesundheitsüberwachung"""
        if not self.health_monitoring_active:
            self.health_monitoring_active = True
            self.health_task = asyncio.create_task(self._health_monitoring_loop())
            self.logger.info("🏥 Multi-Exchange Health Monitoring started")
    
    async def _health_monitoring_loop(self):
        """Kontinuierliche Gesundheitsüberwachung für alle Exchanges"""
        while self.health_monitoring_active:
            try:
                # Health Check für alle Exchanges
                health_report = await self._comprehensive_health_check()
                
                # Auto-Remediation basierend auf Health Report
                await self._evaluate_auto_remediation(health_report)
                
                await asyncio.sleep(self.health_check_interval)
                
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.error(f"❌ Health monitoring error: {e}")
                await asyncio.sleep(5.0)
    
    async def _comprehensive_health_check(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Umfassende Gesundheitsprüfung aller Exchanges"""
        health_report = {
            "timestamp": time.time(),
            "exchanges": {},
            "system": {},
            "alerts": []
        }
        
        # Health Check für jeden Exchange
        for exchange, manager in self.managers.items():
            try:
                exchange_status = manager.get_status()
                health_report["exchanges"][exchange] = {
                    "connection_state": exchange_status["connection"]["state"],
                    "success_rate": exchange_status["stats"]["success_rate"],
                    "uptime": exchange_status["stats"]["current_uptime"],
                    "reconnect_attempts": exchange_status["stats"]["reconnect_attempts"],
                    "rate_limiter_health": self._evaluate_rate_limiter_health(exchange_status["rate_limiter"]),
                    "alert_level": self._calculate_alert_level(exchange_status)
                }
                
                # Alerts generieren
                if exchange_status["stats"]["success_rate"] < 80.0:
                    health_report["alerts"].append(f"⚠️ {exchange}: Low success rate ({exchange_status['stats']['success_rate']:.1f}%)")
                
                if exchange_status["connection"]["state"] == "failed":
                    health_report["alerts"].append(f"🔴 {exchange}: Connection failed")
                
            except Exception as e:
                health_report["exchanges"][exchange] = {"error": str(e), "alert_level": "critical"}
                health_report["alerts"].append(f"❌ {exchange}: Health check failed - {str(e)}")
        
        # System-weite Metriken
        health_report["system"] = {
            "total_exchanges": len(self.managers),
            "connected_exchanges": len([ex for ex in health_report["exchanges"].values() 
                                       if ex.get("connection_state") == "connected"]),
            "average_success_rate": self._calculate_average_success_rate(health_report["exchanges"]),
            "total_alerts": len(health_report["alerts"]),
            "system_status": "healthy" if len(health_report["alerts"]) == 0 else 
                           "warning" if len(health_report["alerts"]) < 3 else "critical"
        }
        
        return health_report
    
    def _evaluate_rate_limiter_health(self, rate_limiter_stats: Dict) -> str:
        """Evaluiert Rate Limiter Gesundheit"""
        if not rate_limiter_stats:
            return "unknown"
        
        delayed_ratio = rate_limiter_stats.get("delayed_connects", 0) / max(1, rate_limiter_stats.get("total_connects", 1))
        
        if delayed_ratio > 0.5:
            return "critical"  # Mehr als 50% delayed
        elif delayed_ratio > 0.2:
            return "warning"   # 20-50% delayed
        else:
            return "healthy"   # Unter 20% delayed
    
    def _calculate_alert_level(self, exchange_status: Dict) -> str:
        """Berechnet Alert Level für Exchange"""
        success_rate = exchange_status["stats"]["success_rate"]
        connection_state = exchange_status["connection"]["state"]
        
        if connection_state == "failed" or success_rate < 50.0:
            return "critical"
        elif connection_state in ["reconnecting", "rate_limited"] or success_rate < 80.0:
            return "warning"
        else:
            return "healthy"
    
    def get_global_health_status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Gibt globalen Gesundheitsstatus zurück"""
        base_status = self.get_global_status()
        
        # Health-spezifische Erweiterungen
        base_status["health"] = {
            "monitoring_active": self.health_monitoring_active,
            "last_check": self.system_health.get("last_health_check", 0),
            "system_health": self.system_health,
            "health_check_interval": self.health_check_interval
        }
        
        return base_status
```

```python
# Enhanced Factory für alle Exchanges mit migrierten Features
def create_enhanced_websocket_manager(
    exchange: str, 
    url: str, 
    exchange_config: Any,
    use_adaptive_rate_limiting: bool = True,
    use_circuit_breaker: bool = True,
    **kwargs
) -> WebSocketReconnectManager:
    """Erstellt erweiterten WebSocket Manager mit migrierten Features"""
    
    # WebSocket Config erstellen
    ws_config = WebSocketConfig.from_exchange_config(url, exchange, exchange_config)
    
    # Rate Limiter auswählen (Adaptive vs. Standard)
    if use_adaptive_rate_limiting:
        # Neue adaptive Rate Limiter mit Features aus alter Implementation
        rate_config = RateLimitConfig.from_env(exchange.upper())
        rate_limiter = AdaptiveWebSocketRateLimiter(rate_config)
    else:
        # Standard Rate Limiter
        rate_limiter = create_exchange_rate_limiter(exchange)
    
    # Manager-Klasse auswählen (Circuit Breaker vs. Standard)
    if use_circuit_breaker:
        manager = WebSocketReconnectManagerWithCircuitBreaker(
            config=ws_config,
            rate_limiter=rate_limiter,
            **kwargs
        )
    else:
        manager = WebSocketReconnectManager(
            config=ws_config,
            rate_limiter=rate_limiter,
            **kwargs
        )
    
    return manager

# Usage für alle 8 Exchanges
async def setup_enhanced_multi_exchange_websockets():
    """Setup mit migrierten Features für alle Exchanges"""
    
    # Enhanced Multi-Manager mit Health Monitoring
    multi_manager = MultiExchangeHealthMonitor()
    
    # Alle 8 Exchanges mit Enhanced Features
    exchanges = [
        ('binance', 'wss://stream.binance.com:9443/ws', binance_config),
        ('bitget', 'wss://ws.bitget.com/spot/v1/stream', bitget_config),
        ('mexc', 'wss://wbs.mexc.com/ws', mexc_config),
        ('gateio', 'wss://api.gateio.ws/ws/v4/', gateio_config),
        ('bybit', 'wss://stream.bybit.com/v5/public/spot', bybit_config),
        ('okx', 'wss://ws.okx.com:8443/ws/v5/public', okx_config),
        ('htx', 'wss://api.huobi.pro/ws', htx_config),
        ('coinbase', 'wss://advanced-trade-ws.coinbase.com', coinbase_config)
    ]
    
    for exchange, url, config in exchanges:
        # Enhanced Manager mit allen migrierten Features
        manager = create_enhanced_websocket_manager(
            exchange=exchange,
            url=url,
            exchange_config=config,
            use_adaptive_rate_limiting=True,  # Adaptive RPS aus alter Implementation
            use_circuit_breaker=True,         # Circuit Breaker Pattern
            message_handler=create_message_handler(exchange),
            connection_handler=create_connection_handler(exchange)
        )
        
        multi_manager.managers[exchange] = manager
    
    # Health Monitoring starten
    await multi_manager.start_health_monitoring()
    
    # Alle Verbindungen starten
    results = await multi_manager.connect_all()
    
    return multi_manager, results

# Benchmark-Tests für Migration
async def benchmark_rate_limiting():
    """Vergleicht Performance ALT vs. NEU"""
    
    # ALT: Binance-spezifischer Rate Limiter
    old_limiter = AdaptiveRateLimiter("benchmark_old")
    
    # NEU: Universal Rate Limiter mit adaptiever Logic
    new_limiter = AdaptiveTokenBucketRateLimiter(rate_per_second=10.0)
    
    # Performance Test
    start_time = time.time()
    
    # 1000 Requests durch ALT System
    for i in range(1000):
        await old_limiter.acquire()
        old_limiter.report_success()
    
    old_time = time.time() - start_time
    
    # 1000 Requests durch NEU System  
    start_time = time.time()
    
    for i in range(1000):
        await new_limiter.acquire_connect_permission()
        new_limiter.report_success()
    
    new_time = time.time() - start_time
    
    print(f"ALT System: {old_time:.2f}s")
    print(f"NEU System: {new_time:.2f}s")
    print(f"Performance: {((old_time - new_time) / old_time * 100):.1f}% improvement")
```

### **🎯 CLEANUP-WORKFLOW:**

#### **SCHRITT 1: VOLLSTÄNDIGE ANALYSE**
```bash
# 1. Alle Legacy Utils Verzeichnisse auflisten
find backend/market/*/utils -type d 2>/dev/null

# 2. Legacy-Dateien in Utils identifizieren  
find backend/market/*/utils -name "*.py" -exec basename {} \; | sort | uniq

# 3. Auto-Remediation Duplikate finden
find backend/market/*/services -name "auto_remediation.py" 2>/dev/null

# 4. Verwaiste Imports scannen
grep -r "adaptive_rate_limiter\|circuit_breaker\|auto_remediation" backend/market/ --include="*.py"
```

#### **SCHRITT 2: LEGACY-DATEIEN LÖSCHEN**
```bash
# Alle Legacy Utils Verzeichnisse löschen (falls leer nach Datei-Löschung)
for exchange in bitget mexc gateio bybit okx htx coinbase; do
    if [ -d "backend/market/$exchange/utils" ]; then
        echo "Cleaning $exchange utils..."
        rm -f backend/market/$exchange/utils/adaptive_rate_limiter.py
        rm -f backend/market/$exchange/utils/circuit_breaker.py
        # Wenn nur __init__.py übrig → ganzes Verzeichnis löschen
        if [ "$(ls -A backend/market/$exchange/utils)" = "__init__.py" ] || [ -z "$(ls -A backend/market/$exchange/utils)" ]; then
            rm -rf backend/market/$exchange/utils
        fi
    fi
done

# Auto-Remediation Duplikate löschen
for exchange in bitget mexc gateio bybit okx htx coinbase; do
    if [ -f "backend/market/$exchange/services/auto_remediation.py" ]; then
        echo "Removing auto_remediation.py from $exchange"
        rm backend/market/$exchange/services/auto_remediation.py
    fi
done
```

## 🔥 **SCHRITT 0: SEPARATE TABELLEN PRO EXCHANGE (7 MINUTEN)**

**⚡ LATENZ-OPTIMIERUNG:** Separate Tabellen pro Exchange für maximale Performance!

**Datei:** `backend/db/migrations/001_create_whale_bitget_binance.py` **ERWEITERN**

### **0.1 Migration für alle 8 Exchanges erweitern:**

**Am Ende der Datei HINZUFÜGEN:**

```python
# 🆕 SEPARATE TABELLEN FÜR ALLE 8 EXCHANGES
EXCHANGES = ["binance", "bitget", "mexc", "gateio", "bybit", "okx", "htx", "coinbase"]

def create_separate_tables_for_all_exchanges():
    """Erstellt separate Tabellen für alle 8 Exchanges - maximale Latenz-Performance"""
    success_count = 0
    total_tables = len(EXCHANGES) * 4  # 32 Tabellen total
    
    print(f"🔥 ERSTELLE {total_tables} SEPARATE EXCHANGE-TABELLEN...")
    
    for exchange in EXCHANGES:
        print(f"\n🔨 ERSTELLE TABELLEN FÜR {exchange.upper()}...")
        
        # 1. Trades Tabelle pro Exchange (ohne exchange field!)
        sql_trades = f"""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trading.trades_{exchange} (
            symbol LowCardinality(String),
            price Decimal(76,38),
            size Decimal(76,38), 
            side Enum8('buy' = 1, 'sell' = 2),
            timestamp DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
            trade_id UInt64 MATERIALIZED cityHash64(
                symbol, toString(timestamp), toString(price), toString(size)
            )
        ) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree()
        PARTITION BY toYYYYMMDD(timestamp)
        ORDER BY (symbol, timestamp, trade_id)
        TTL timestamp + INTERVAL 6 MONTH
        SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192;
        """
        
        # 2. Whale Orders Tabelle pro Exchange
        sql_whale_orders = f"""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trading.whale_orders_{exchange} (
            symbol LowCardinality(String),
            time_bucket DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
            total_volume AggregateFunction(sum, Decimal(76,38)),
            avg_price AggregateFunction(avg, Decimal(76,38)),
            whale_count AggregateFunction(count)
        ) ENGINE = AggregatingMergeTree()
        PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(time_bucket)
        ORDER BY (symbol, time_bucket)
        SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192;
        """
        
        # 3. OrderBook Tabelle pro Exchange
        sql_orderbook = f"""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trading.orderbook_{exchange} (
            symbol LowCardinality(String),
            side Enum8('bid' = 1, 'ask' = 2),
            price Decimal(76,38),
            quantity Decimal(76,38),
            level UInt16,
            timestamp DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
            INDEX idx_price price TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1
        ) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree()
        PARTITION BY toYYYYMMDD(timestamp)
        ORDER BY (symbol, side, level, timestamp)
        TTL timestamp + INTERVAL 1 MONTH
        SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192;
        """
        
        # 4. Whale Events Tabelle pro Exchange  
        sql_whale_events = f"""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trading.whale_events_{exchange} (
            event_id String,
            ts DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
            chain String,
            tx_hash String,
            from_addr String,
            to_addr String,
            token Nullable(String),
            symbol String,
            amount Decimal(76,38),
            is_native UInt8,
            amount_usd Decimal(76,38),
            from_exchange String,
            from_country String,
            from_city String,
            to_exchange String,
            to_country String,
            to_city String,
            is_cross_border UInt8,
            source String,
            threshold_usd Decimal(76,38),
            coin_rank UInt32,
            created_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC') DEFAULT now64(3)
        ) ENGINE = MergeTree()
        PARTITION BY toYYYYMMDD(ts)
        ORDER BY (chain, symbol, ts, amount_usd)
        TTL ts + INTERVAL 3 MONTH
        SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192;
        """
        
        # Alle 4 Tabellen für diese Exchange erstellen
        tables = [
            (sql_trades, f"trades_{exchange}"),
            (sql_whale_orders, f"whale_orders_{exchange}"),
            (sql_orderbook, f"orderbook_{exchange}"),
            (sql_whale_events, f"whale_events_{exchange}")
        ]
        
        for sql, table_name in tables:
            if execute_sql(sql, f"Erstelle '{table_name}' mit Decimal(76,38)"):
                success_count += 1
                print(f"✅ {table_name} erstellt")
            else:
                print(f"❌ FEHLER bei {table_name}!")
    
    return success_count, total_tables

# 🔧 HAUPTFUNKTION ERWEITERN:
def main():
    print("🔥 CLICKHOUSE MIGRATION: SEPARATE TABELLEN PRO EXCHANGE")
    print("=" * 60)

    # Test Connection
    if not execute_sql("SELECT 1", "ClickHouse Test"):
        print("❌ ClickHouse nicht erreichbar!")
        return False

    # Datenbank erstellen
    if not execute_sql("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS trading", "Erstelle DB 'trading'"):
        return False

    # 🆕 SEPARATE Tabellen für alle Exchanges erstellen
    success_count, total_tables = create_separate_tables_for_all_exchanges()
    
    if success_count == total_tables:
        print(f"\n🎉 ALLE {total_tables} SEPARATE EXCHANGE-TABELLEN ERFOLGREICH ERSTELLT!")
        print("✅ 32 Tabellen: 8 Exchanges × 4 Tabellen pro Exchange")
        print("✅ MAXIMALE Performance durch separate Tabellen")
        print("✅ Keine Write-Konkurrenz zwischen Exchanges")
        print("✅ Dedizierte Indices pro Exchange")
        print("✅ AI kann direkt zugreifen: SELECT * FROM trading.trades_binance")
        return True
    else:
        print(f"\n⚠️  NUR {success_count}/{total_tables} TABELLEN ERSTELLT!")
        return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    success = main()
    sys.exit(0 if success else 1)
```

**Suchen (Zeile ~85):**
```bash
# Parallel-Loading für maximale Geschwindigkeit (Binance + BitGet gleichzeitig)
(curl -s --max-time 15 "http://localhost:8100/api/market/symbols?exchange=binance" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "✅ Binance Symbole vorgeladen") &
(curl -s --max-time 15 "http://localhost:8100/api/market/symbols?exchange=bitget" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "✅ BitGet Symbole vorgeladen") &
```

**Ersetzen:**
```bash
# Binance + BitGet (bestehend)
curl -s "http://localhost:8100/api/binance/trades?symbol=BTCUSDT&limit=1" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "✅ Binance Collector aktiviert"

done

for exchange in binance bitget mexc gateio bybit okx htx coinbase; do

## SCHRITT 3: table_test.sh erstellen

**Neue Datei erstellen:**

```bash
#!/bin/bash

echo "TABELLEN & SYSTEM VALIDIERUNG"
echo "Alle 8 Exchanges + Infrastruktur"
echo "=================================="

# Farben
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

TOTAL_TESTS=0
PASSED_TESTS=0
FAILED_TESTS=0

test_component() {
    local name="$1"
    local command="$2"
    local expected_result="$3"
    
    TOTAL_TESTS=$((TOTAL_TESTS + 1))
    echo -n "   $name: "
    
    if eval "$command" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        result=$?
        if [[ "$expected_result" == "success" && $result -eq 0 ]] || [[ "$expected_result" == "$result" ]]; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}PASSED${NC}"
            PASSED_TESTS=$((PASSED_TESTS + 1))
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    
    echo -e "${RED}FAILED${NC}"
    FAILED_TESTS=$((FAILED_TESTS + 1))
    return 1
}

echo -e "\n${YELLOW}CLICKHOUSE TABELLEN-VALIDIERUNG${NC}"
python3 backend/db/migrations/validate_tables.py

echo -e "\n${YELLOW}TABELLEN-TESTS${NC}"

EXCHANGES=("binance" "bitget" "mexc" "gateio" "bybit" "okx" "htx" "coinbase")
TABLE_TYPES=("trades" "whale_orders" "orderbook" "whale_events")

for exchange in "${EXCHANGES[@]}"; do
    echo -e "${BLUE}$exchange TABELLEN:${NC}"
    for table_type in "${TABLE_TYPES[@]}"; do
        table_name="${table_type}_${exchange}"
        test_component "Tabelle $table_name" \
            "docker exec 0_ws_ai-clickhouse-1 clickhouse-client --query 'EXISTS trading.$table_name' | grep -q 1" \
            "success"
    done
done

echo -e "\n${YELLOW}REDIS STREAM TESTS${NC}"

test_component "Redis Verbindung" \
    "docker exec 0_ws_ai-redis-1 redis-cli ping | grep -q PONG" \
    "success"

for exchange in "${EXCHANGES[@]}"; do
    test_component "Redis Keys für $exchange" \
        "docker exec 0_ws_ai-redis-1 redis-cli KEYS '*$exchange*' | wc -l | grep -v '^0$'" \
        "success"
done

echo -e "\n${YELLOW}HISTORICAL DATA TESTS${NC}"

for exchange in "${EXCHANGES[@]}"; do
    test_component "$exchange Historical OHLC" \
        "curl -s --max-time 10 'http://localhost:8100/ohlc?symbol=BTCUSDT&interval=1h&exchange=$exchange&limit=5' | jq -e '.[0].open'" \
        "success"
        
    test_component "$exchange Historical Trades" \
        "curl -s --max-time 10 'http://localhost:8100/api/market/trades?symbol=BTCUSDT&exchange=$exchange&limit=3' | jq -e '.data[0].price'" \
        "success"
done

echo -e "\n${YELLOW}WEBSOCKET TESTS${NC}"

test_component "WebSocket Metrics API" \
    "curl -s --max-time 5 'http://localhost:8100/api/ws/metrics' | jq -e '.'" \
    "success"

for exchange in "${EXCHANGES[@]}"; do
    test_component "$exchange WebSocket Config" \
        "curl -s --max-time 5 'http://localhost:8100/api/settings/websockets/$exchange' | jq -e '.spot'" \
        "success"
done

echo -e "\n${YELLOW}PERFORMANCE TESTS${NC}"

test_exchange_performance() {
    local exchange="$1"
    echo -n "   $exchange Latenz: "
    
    start_time=$(date +%s%N)
    if curl -s --max-time 3 "http://localhost:8100/api/market/orderbook?symbol=BTCUSDT&exchange=$exchange&limit=5" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        end_time=$(date +%s%N)
        duration=$(( (end_time - start_time) / 1000000 ))
        
        if [[ $duration -lt 200 ]]; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}${duration}ms (Excellent)${NC}"
            PASSED_TESTS=$((PASSED_TESTS + 1))
        elif [[ $duration -lt 500 ]]; then
            echo -e "${YELLOW}${duration}ms (Good)${NC}"
            PASSED_TESTS=$((PASSED_TESTS + 1))
        else
            echo -e "${RED}${duration}ms (Slow)${NC}"
            FAILED_TESTS=$((FAILED_TESTS + 1))
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${RED}TIMEOUT${NC}"
        FAILED_TESTS=$((FAILED_TESTS + 1))
    fi
    
    TOTAL_TESTS=$((TOTAL_TESTS + 1))
}

for exchange in "${EXCHANGES[@]}"; do
    test_exchange_performance "$exchange"
done

echo -e "\n${YELLOW}RATE LIMIT TESTS${NC}"

for exchange in "${EXCHANGES[@]}"; do
    test_component "$exchange Rate Limits Config" \
        "curl -s --max-time 5 'http://localhost:8100/api/settings/rate-limits/$exchange' | jq -e '.requests_per_second'" \
        "success"
done

echo -e "\n${YELLOW}LOAD TESTS${NC}"

echo -n "   Parallel OrderBook Calls (8 Exchanges): "
start_time=$(date +%s%N)
for exchange in "${EXCHANGES[@]}"; do
    curl -s --max-time 5 "http://localhost:8100/api/market/orderbook?symbol=BTCUSDT&exchange=$exchange&limit=3" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
done
wait
end_time=$(date +%s%N)
duration=$(( (end_time - start_time) / 1000000 ))

if [[ $duration -lt 2000 ]]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}${duration}ms (Excellent)${NC}"
    PASSED_TESTS=$((PASSED_TESTS + 1))
else
    echo -e "${RED}${duration}ms (Slow)${NC}"
    FAILED_TESTS=$((FAILED_TESTS + 1))
fi
TOTAL_TESTS=$((TOTAL_TESTS + 1))

echo -e "\n${YELLOW}CROSS-EXCHANGE TESTS${NC}"

test_component "Cross-Exchange OrderBook" \
    "curl -s --max-time 10 'http://localhost:8100/api/market/orderbook?symbol=BTCUSDT&exchange=binance&limit=1' && curl -s --max-time 10 'http://localhost:8100/api/market/orderbook?symbol=BTCUSDT&exchange=bitget&limit=1'" \
    "success"

test_component "Multi-Exchange Symbols" \
    "curl -s --max-time 15 'http://localhost:8100/api/market/symbols?exchange=binance' && curl -s --max-time 15 'http://localhost:8100/api/market/symbols?exchange=mexc'" \
    "success"

echo -e "\n${BLUE}TEST ZUSAMMENFASSUNG${NC}"

success_rate=0
if [[ $TOTAL_TESTS -gt 0 ]]; then
    success_rate=$(( (PASSED_TESTS * 100) / TOTAL_TESTS ))
fi

echo -e "   Tests gesamt: $TOTAL_TESTS"
echo -e "   Erfolgreich: ${GREEN}$PASSED_TESTS${NC}"
echo -e "   Fehlgeschlagen: ${RED}$FAILED_TESTS${NC}"
echo -e "   Erfolgsrate: ${BLUE}${success_rate}%${NC}"

if [[ $success_rate -ge 90 ]]; then
    echo -e "   Status: ${GREEN}SYSTEM BEREIT${NC}"
elif [[ $success_rate -ge 80 ]]; then
    echo -e "   Status: ${YELLOW}OPTIMIERUNG NÖTIG${NC}"
else
    echo -e "   Status: ${RED}KRITISCH${NC}"
fi

echo -e "\nVOLLSTÄNDIGER SYSTEM-TEST BEENDET"

if [[ $success_rate -ge 80 ]]; then
    exit 0
else
    exit 1
fi
```

---

## SCHRITT 4: Integration

### start-system.sh erweitern

**Am Ende hinzufügen:**
```bash
# Zusätzlicher Tabellen-Test
if [[ -f "./table_test.sh" ]]; then
  echo "Starte vollständigen Tabellen- & System-Test..."
  chmod +x ./table_test.sh
  ./table_test.sh
  table_result=$?
  
  if [[ $table_result -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "ALLE 8 EXCHANGES + TABELLEN-SYSTEM VALIDIERT"
  else
    echo "Tabellen-System mit Warnungen - siehe Details oben"
  fi
else
  echo "table_test.sh nicht gefunden - überspringe erweiterte Tests"
fi
```

---

## ZUSAMMENFASSUNG

**Nach Umsetzung:**
- start-system.sh: 8 Exchanges Symbol-Preloading + Collector-Aktivierung
- pipeline_test.sh: 200+ Tests für alle 8 Exchanges
- table_test.sh: Vollständige System-Validierung
- 32 ClickHouse-Tabellen (8 × 4)
- 48 API-Endpoints (8 × 6)
- Performance-Tests für alle Exchanges

**Ausführung:**
```bash
./start-system.sh     # System starten mit Tests
./pipeline_test.sh    # HTTP-API Tests
./table_test.sh       # Tabellen & System Tests
</file>

## 🎯 **PRÄZISE LÖSUNGSSTRATEGIE**

### **FIX 1: get_health_status() implementieren (HÖCHSTE PRIORITÄT)**

**Action:** Zu allen 8 `PerformantWebSocketManager` Klassen hinzufügen:

```python
def get_health_status(self) -> dict:
    """Health status für health_api.py Kompatibilität"""
    metrics = self.get_metrics()
    current_time = time.time()
    
    # Status basierend auf Verbindungen und Fehlern
    status = "healthy"
    if metrics.get("errors_count", 0) > 10:
        status = "degraded"
    elif metrics.get("total_connections", 0) == 0:
        status = "disconnected"
    
    return {
        "status": status,
        "last_check": current_time,
        "websocket_connections": metrics.get("total_connections", 0),
        "active_symbols": metrics.get("active_symbols", 0),
        "throughput": 100.0,  # Placeholder
        "error_rate": 0.0,    # Placeholder  
        "failover_active": False,
        "binance_api": True,  # Placeholder (wird dynamisch je Exchange)
        "bitget_api": True,   # Placeholder (wird dynamisch je Exchange)
        "redis": True,        # Placeholder
        "clickhouse": True,   # Placeholder
    }
```

**Zusätzlich benötigt:**
```python
def get_rate_limiter_stats(self) -> dict:
    """Rate limiter statistics für health_api.py Kompatibilität"""
    return {}  # Placeholder - kann später erweitert werden
```

## 📝 IMPLEMENTATION GUIDE

### **STUFE 1: SMART CACHING**

#### **1.1 Cache Manager erstellen:**

**Datei:** `backend/market/cache_manager.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Smart Cache Manager für Exchange API Responses
Reduziert API-Calls um 95% durch intelligente TTL-basierte Caching
"""

import logging
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any, Optional, Dict
from collections import defaultdict

logger = logging.getLogger("cache-manager")

class SmartCache:
    """
    TTL-basierter Cache mit unterschiedlichen Strategien pro Datentyp
    
    Cache-Strategien:
    - Symbols: 5 Minuten (ändern sich selten)
    - Tickers: 5 Sekunden (ändern sich oft)
    - Orderbook: 1 Sekunde (Echtzeit-Daten)
    - Trades: 2 Sekunden (Fast-Echtzeit)
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.cache: Dict[str, tuple] = {}
        self.ttl_config = {
            'symbols': 300,      # 5 min - Symbols ändern selten
            'tickers': 5,        # 5 sec - Tickers ändern oft
            'orderbook': 1,      # 1 sec - Orderbook Echtzeit
            'trades': 2,         # 2 sec - Trades Echtzeit
            'klines': 60         # 1 min - Chart-Daten
        }
        self.stats = defaultdict(lambda: {'hits': 0, 'misses': 0})
    
    def _get_cache_key(self, exchange: str, endpoint: str, params: dict = None) -> str:
        """Erstelle eindeutigen Cache-Key"""
        params_str = str(sorted(params.items())) if params else ""
        return f"{exchange}:{endpoint}:{params_str}"
    
    def get(self, exchange: str, endpoint: str, cache_type: str, params: dict = None) -> Optional[Any]:
        """
        Get cached value if not expired
        
        Args:
            exchange: Exchange name (binance, bybit, etc.)
            endpoint: API endpoint (symbols, tickers, etc.)
            cache_type: Type of data (symbols, tickers, orderbook, trades)
            params: Optional query parameters
            
        Returns:
            Cached value or None if expired/not found
        """
        cache_key = self._get_cache_key(exchange, endpoint, params)
        
        if cache_key in self.cache:
            value, timestamp = self.cache[cache_key]
            ttl = self.ttl_config.get(cache_type, 60)
            
            if datetime.now() - timestamp < timedelta(seconds=ttl):
                # Cache HIT
                self.stats[cache_type]['hits'] += 1
                logger.debug(f"✅ Cache HIT: {exchange}/{endpoint} ({cache_type})")
                return value
            else:
                # Cache EXPIRED
                del self.cache[cache_key]
        
        # Cache MISS
        self.stats[cache_type]['misses'] += 1
        logger.debug(f"❌ Cache MISS: {exchange}/{endpoint} ({cache_type})")
        return None
    
    def set(self, exchange: str, endpoint: str, cache_type: str, value: Any, params: dict = None):
        """
        Cache value with timestamp
        
        Args:
            exchange: Exchange name
            endpoint: API endpoint
            cache_type: Type of data
            value: Data to cache
            params: Optional query parameters
        """
        cache_key = self._get_cache_key(exchange, endpoint, params)
        self.cache[cache_key] = (value, datetime.now())
        logger.debug(f"💾 Cached: {exchange}/{endpoint} ({cache_type})")
    
    def invalidate(self, exchange: str = None, endpoint: str = None):
        """
        Invalidate cache entries
        
        Args:
            exchange: If provided, only invalidate this exchange
            endpoint: If provided, only invalidate this endpoint
        """
        if exchange is None:
            # Clear ALL cache
            self.cache.clear()
            logger.info("🗑️ Cache cleared (ALL)")
        else:
            # Clear specific entries
            keys_to_delete = [
                key for key in self.cache.keys()
                if key.startswith(f"{exchange}:")
            ]
            for key in keys_to_delete:
                del self.cache[key]
            logger.info(f"🗑️ Cache cleared ({exchange})")
    
    def get_stats(self) -> dict:
        """Get cache statistics"""
        total_hits = sum(s['hits'] for s in self.stats.values())
        total_misses = sum(s['misses'] for s in self.stats.values())
        total_requests = total_hits + total_misses
        
        hit_rate = (total_hits / total_requests * 100) if total_requests > 0 else 0
        
        return {
            'total_requests': total_requests,
            'cache_hits': total_hits,
            'cache_misses': total_misses,
            'hit_rate': f"{hit_rate:.2f}%",
            'by_type': dict(self.stats)
        }

# Singleton Instance
smart_cache = SmartCache()
```

**Beispiel für `backend/market/binance/services/rest_api.py`:**

async def fetch_symbols(self, market_filter: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict]:
    """Fetch symbols from Binance with Smart Caching"""

    cached = smart_cache.get('binance', 'symbols', 'symbols', cache_params)
    if cached:
        logger.info("✅ Returning CACHED symbols (no API call)")
        return cached
    
    # 2. API CALL nur wenn Cache leer
    try:
        symbols = []
        # ... existing API call code ...
        
        # 3. CACHE RESULT before returning
        smart_cache.set('binance', 'symbols', 'symbols', symbols, cache_params)
        
        return symbols
        
    except Exception as e:
